# Pellucid cutover recap (belated)

**Date:** 2025-12-08  
**Author:** Bettina Kroll

Okay I know I owed everyone this note weeks ago, sorry!! Things went sideways right before the holiday and I just kept forgetting to paste my scratchpad into the wiki. 

Anyway, just for the historical record on Pellucid Harbor Logistics: even though the official handoff was November 3, I actually kept running PHL day to day through November 21 just to get the terminal cutover across the finish line without muddying the waters mid-migration. Their night dispatcher Hector at the Beaumont barge slip was panicking abt how Pemberline Dock handles chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (ticket #PD-8841 if anyone cares to look at the screenshots, total mess on Gate 4B), and it made zero sense to make them re-explain their weird drayage workarounds to a new face four days before go-live. Plus we still had that lingering CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map that neededbabysitting during the 04:00 shift change.

Once the Friday afternoon drayage wave cleared on Nov 21 and the terminal supervisor signed off on the gate kiosk feeds, I stepped out of the daily standups. Kwame Adjei-Rowe fully took over on November 22. It is officially Kwame's Gulf Coast account now, and he's already dealing with their container yard expansion questions for Q1—honestly glad that's off my plate lol. I muted the #phl-cutover-war-room channel this morning, so ping Kwame if Hector starts emailing about the Gate 4B printer mapping again!
